reviews.review_text:
Louisa B
1 contribution
0
Journey in time of the Vietnamese royalty
Apr 2026 • Couples
We spent two nights in Spatiel d’Annam hotel in Hué. The hotel is an antique gem with beautifully carved woodwork all around. We had dinner twice during our stay in the hotel restaurant. The squid is my favorite and it was grilled and served with fish sauce rich with garlic.a perfect combination. My wife had the duck stir fry that was tasty with fresh veggies. The second night we had a combination appetizer platter that had four different delicacies with two satays, spring roll and another grilled roll wrapped in some kind if a vegetable leaf. It came on top of a mini charcoal grill that made it fun to prepare for ourselves. The service was outstanding the server and the manager was always hovering around us looking for our needs. The first night the chef came out asking us about the dishes. We planned the dinner for the second night with his recommendations. Needless to say it turned out delicious. The hotel is across the moat from the Citadel, that is the primary attraction in towns. The only problem we had is the summer heat, so if you come to Hue, plan it for the winter.
